card.name: Leading digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts or sits inside a number and is followed by more digits, a decimal, or a range dash. It is seen mostly in dose amounts, activity ranges (MBq, mCi) and large counts.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: The first digit of a dose or range such as 5 mg, 8-12 mCi or 2.5 mg.

modes.label: Large numbers in general text
modes.description: The first digit of a large figure with a comma, such as a speed or a population.

card.writes: It promotes number-scale words like hundred, fifty, sixty and ninety, which suggests the number is about to continue.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number that is still going, mostly a dose amount.
